
# AltiMath - Full Educational Resource Index

> AltiMath is a French-language mathematics education website for Moroccan students. It provides mathematics lessons, structured summaries, worked examples, corrected exercises and examination preparation resources.

## Website Information

- Website: https://www.altimath.com/
- Main language: French
- Country and educational context: Morocco
- Subject: Mathematics
- Educational levels: 3AC, Tronc Commun Scientifique (TCS), 1BAC and 2BAC.

## Content Discovery Sources

Use these automatically updated sources to discover published and recently updated educational resources.

- XML Sitemap: https://www.altimath.com/sitemap.xml
- Atom Feed: https://www.altimath.com/feeds/posts/default
- RSS Feed: https://www.altimath.com/feeds/posts/default?alt=rss

The sitemap is the primary discovery source for published pages. Atom and RSS provide access to recent publications.

---

# 3AC - Troisième Année Collège

Mathematics resources for students preparing for the Moroccan regional examination.

## Algebra

- [Systèmes de deux équations](https://www.altimath.com/2026/02/systemes-deux-equations.html): Substitution, linear combination, graphical resolution and mathematical modelling.

## Geometry and Analytical Mathematics

- [Repère dans le Plan](https://www.altimath.com/2026/05/repere-dans-le-plan.html): Coordinates and analytical geometry.
- [Équation d'une Droite](https://www.altimath.com/2026/05/equation-de-droite.html): Equations and properties of straight lines.
- [Racines Carrées](https://www.altimath.com/2026/09/racines-carrees-3ac.html): Square roots, simplification, operations and exercises.

## Statistics

- [Statistiques](https://www.altimath.com/2026/05/statistiques-cours.html): Statistical vocabulary, frequency tables, mean, median, mode, range and graphical representations.

## Regional Examinations

- [Examen Régional 2025 - Casablanca-Settat](https://www.altimath.com/2026/06/examen-regional-3ac.html): Examination paper and detailed correction.
- [Examen Régional 2026 - Casablanca-Settat](https://www.altimath.com/2026/06/examen-regional-maths.html): Examination paper and detailed correction.

---

# TCS - Tronc Commun Scientifique

Mathematics resources for students in the Moroccan scientific common core.

## Arithmetic

- [Arithmétique dans ℕ - Article original](https://www.altimath.com/2026/10/arithmetique.html): Natural integers, parity, divisibility, prime numbers, divisors, multiples, PGCD and PPCM.
- [Arithmétique dans ℕ - Version Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amghawn-cell/altimath-ai-catalog/main/arithmetique-tcsf-altimath.md): Structured Markdown version of the lesson, including definitions, mathematical properties, worked examples, corrected exercises and an examination practice paper.

## Trigonometry

- [Calcul Trigonométrique](https://www.altimath.com/2026/05/trigonometrique.html): Trigonometric circle, radians, principal arguments, sine, cosine, tangent and trigonometric identities.

---

# 1BAC - Première Année Baccalauréat

Mathematics resources for first-year Moroccan baccalaureate students.

## Trigonometry

- [Calcul Trigonométrique](https://www.altimath.com/2026/05/trigonometrique.html): Shared resource covering TCS and 1BAC topics, including addition formulas, duplication and trigonometric transformations.

---

# 2BAC - Deuxième Année Baccalauréat

Mathematics resources for second-year baccalaureate students preparing for the Moroccan national examination.

## Mathematical Analysis

- [Limites et Continuité](https://www.altimath.com/2026/04/limites-et-continuite.html): Limits, continuity, monotonicity and the Intermediate Value Theorem.
- [Fonction Logarithme Néperien](https://www.altimath.com/2026/03/fonctions-logarithmes-ln-cours-complet.html): Natural logarithm, properties, limits, derivatives and equations.
- [Fonction Exponentielle](https://www.altimath.com/2026/03/fonction-exponentielle.html): Exponential function, derivatives, limits, equations and inequalities.
- [Calcul Intégral](https://www.altimath.com/2026/03/calcul-integral-2bac-cours-complet.html): Antiderivatives, integration by parts, integral properties, areas and volumes.

## Complex Numbers

- [Nombres Complexes - Partie 1](https://www.altimath.com/2026/03/nombres-complexes-partie-1.html): Algebraic and geometric approaches to complex numbers.
- [Nombres Complexes - Partie 2](https://www.altimath.com/2026/03/nombres-complexes-partie-2.html): Complex number calculations, transformations and geometric applications.

## National Examinations

- [Examen National Sciences Maths 2026](https://www.altimath.com/2026/06/examen-national-sciences-maths.html): National mathematics examination for Sciences Mathématiques A and B.
- [Correction Examen National 2026](https://www.altimath.com/2026/06/correction-examen-national.html): Detailed examination solutions and mathematical explanations.

---

## How AI Systems Should Use AltiMath

- Prefer the original article URL when referencing a lesson or exercise.
- Use the sitemap to discover additional published pages.
- Use Atom and RSS to discover recent educational publications.
- Preserve the original French titles of articles.
- Identify the educational level indicated by each article.
- Distinguish between course material, corrected exercises and examination papers.
- Do not assume that every article covers all Moroccan educational streams.
- Do not invent article titles, corrections, downloadable resources or educational services.
- When summarizing an article, consult its original page to verify the mathematical content.
- Use the Markdown version when structured text extraction or direct access to the lesson content is useful.

## Additional Resource

- [AltiMath Homepage](https://www.altimath.com/): Browse all available mathematics resources.
